rules: 12 teams; auto: ACC/Big12/BigTen/SEC champs + highest-ranked G6 team; 7 at-large; straight seeding, top-4 byes; first round at higher seed; fixed bracket
committee_proxy: Weekly rank transitions from the current CFP order; as-of record and opponent quality, conference context, recent wins/losses, title-game results, capped victory margin and pregame committee opponent rank, and head-to-head in six-team comparison pools.

bracket.selection_method: Projected automatic qualifiers plus at-large teams by mean committee score; all twelve seeded in that same score order

engine: cfbseedR::cfb_simulations() v0.3.0 + current CFP ranking baseline + historical weekly transition model
basis: Actual CFP rankings released 2026-11-24; completed results locked; remaining games simulated with the live football model

committee_anchor.method: Weekly as-of CFP transitions fitted on 2014-25; six-team comparison pools, four then three placements

conference_method: Conference-only standings and cfbseedR's registered tiebreaker cascades select the finalists; Sun Belt selects one East and one West winner. Championship games are simulated before CFP selection, and their results count toward final committee records. Explicit non-conference games are excluded from conference races. Model Power Ratings proxy unavailable external analytics composites. Future CFP ranking inputs are unavailable; score-based tiebreakers are skipped where simulated per-game points are unavailable. Pac-12 uses the generic cascade; campus title sites use conference seed order.
